verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs confirm it has a Tab completion feature: the API-keys page says tab completion runs on Cursor's built-in models, and the Analytics API reports team tab usage and accepted AI-suggested edits. However, no evidence describes how inline completions behave as you type, and next-edit suggestions are never documented. missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs on inline completion behavior, evidence of next-edit/multi-line edit prediction, independent hands-on corroboration of completion quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type

citations.quote: Tab completion continues using Cursor's built-in models
